dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge curvature with a pronounced inward sweep (falcate) starting from the apex and terminating in a slight notch near the peduncle junction.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a narrow radius of curvature, forming a distinct convex arc at the maximum vertical extremity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin rising at an approximate 55-60 degree incline relative to the visible horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height exceeds base width, resulting in an estimated 1:1.3 width-to-height ratio.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular nicks and indentations visible along the distal half of the trailing edge; white punctate speckling across the lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-to-light gradient on the posterior base of the fin where it integrates with the dorsal ridge.
